title: The James Trading Group Recalls Kids Sports Hoodie Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring around the neck area which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Drawstrings can become entangled or caught on playground slides, hand rails, school bus doors or other moving objects, posing a significant strangulation and/or entanglement hazard to children. Uni

title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls Cannondale Mountain Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The OPI stem/steering tube assemblies can fail, posing a risk of injury from a fall. Units: About 23,000 (in addition, about 800 were sold in Canada).

title: Prestone Products Recalls Windshield De-Icer and Ice and Frost Shield Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement
summary: The trigger spray assembly can be removed from the De-Icer and Frost Shield container. The product contains methanol and ethylene glycol. Children may gain access to the product by removing the trigger assembly, posing a risk of poisoning. Units: About 4.1 million.

title: Imagine Nation Books Recalls Pink Giraffe Animal Purse Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The red paint on the zipper contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 630.

title: Sleeping Partners Recalls Moses Basket and Stand Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The Moses basket fails to meet the federal hand-held infant carrier standard and the stand fails to meet the bassinet/cradle standard. The basket can slide off an inclined surface and the stand can tip, posing a fall hazard for infants. Units: About 5,500 baskets and 800 stands.

title: MiWorld Accessories Recalls Plug-in Wall Chargers for iPhones Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Charlotte Russe Stores
summary: The chargers can overheat and catch fire while in use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,200.

title: Bed Handles Inc. Reannounces Recall of Adult Portable Bed Handles Due to Serious Entrapment and Strangulation Hazards
summary: When attached to an adult's bed without the use of safety retention straps, the handle can shift out of place, creating a dangerous gap between the bed handle and the side of the mattress. This poses a serious risk of entrapment, strangulation and death. Units: About 113,000.

title: The Land of Nod Recalls Mobiles Due to Entanglement and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The yarn from the sheep figures can unravel, posing an entanglement and strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 400.

title: Zak Designs Recalls Water Bottles Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target Stores
summary: The inner plastic straw in the flip-top portion of the twist-off cap can break, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 178,000.

title: Bradshaw International Recalls Jumbo Roasters Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The roaster rim is incorrectly finished and can have sharp edges, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 146,000.

title: Segway Recalls Off-Board Chargers for Segway Personal Transporters Due to Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A wire inside the charger can detach and touch the side of the charger, posing a shock hazard. Units: About 17.

title: Juratoys Recalls Fishing Games Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The plastic worm at the end of the fishing pole line can separate, producing small parts that pose a choking hazard to children. Additionally, the small magnet inside the worm can liberate. Swallowing multiple magnets can result in serious internal injury. Units: About 14,000 (In addition, about 200

title: Philips Recalls Halogen Bulbs Due to Laceration and Burn Hazards
summary: The lens of the bulb can shatter in the lamp or the lens can fall and shatter, posing a laceration and burn hazard. Units: About 370,000.

title: Touchless Kitchen Faucets Recalled by Lota Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The battery box used to power the faucet's sensor can short circuit, overheat and/or melt, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 4,500.

title: Bosch Security Systems Recalls Wireless Smoke Alarms Due to Failure to Alert Consumers to a Fire (Recall Alert)
summary: The alarms can fail to alert consumers to a fire, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 950.

title: Cabrinha Recalls Kiteboard Control Systems Due to Risk of Injury; Trim Line Can Break
summary: The point of connection between the kiteboard's trim line and the depower mainline can break, and cause a loss of control, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 750.

title: Kenwood Recalls Blenders Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The lower blade can break during use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 150 in the U.S. (an additional 860 sold in Canada).

title: Mini Bikes Recalled by Baja Motorsports Due to Fall and Crash Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Tractor Supply Company
summary: The front fork can separate from the wheel, posing fall and crash hazards to riders. Units: About 4,600.

title: Panasonic Recalls Metal Cutter Saws Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The lower blade guard can get stuck in the fully retracted position and not automatically release to cover the blade. The exposed blade poses a laceration hazard and risk of injury. Units: About 165.

title: IKEA Recalls Crib Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The crib mattresses fail to meet the federal open flame standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 38,400 (VYSSA SPELEVINK crib mattresses were previously recalled in January 2015 and again in May 2015 for entrapment hazards.).

title: Nestlé Waters North America Recalls Water Dispensers Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The screws holding the heat band in the dispensers can break or detach and cause the unit to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 190.

title: Rejuvenation Recalls Shaker Chairs and Bar Stools Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The legs and back of these products can break, causing the person sitting on the chair or stool to fall. Units: About 780.

title: Technical Consumer Products Recalls Connected Brand Downlights Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The internal wiring in the LED downlights can contact the downlight's metal trim, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 24,400 (in addition, 6,200 units were sold in Canada).

title: Millennium Outdoors Recalls Tree Stands Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The seat on the tree stand can bend in a downward angle, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 1,400.

title: Shivvers Recalls Country Clipper Lawn Mowers Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The gas cap threads do not align with threads of the fuel tanks opening, which can allow fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 450.

title: Calphalon Recalls Pizza Wheels Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The handle of the pizza cutter can detach during use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 328,000 in U.S. (in addition, 8,300 were sold in Canada).

title: Chewbeads Recalls Pacifier Clips Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The "D" ring on the pacifier clip can break, allowing beads to detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 45,000 in United States (in addition about 5,900 were sold in Canada).

title: Madewell Expands Recall of Women's Sandals Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The metal shank can dislodge and break through bottom of the outsole, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 570 in the United States (in addition, 3 were sold in Canada) (Madewell recalled 50,600 women's Sightseer sandals in August 2015 for the same hazard).

title: Rattan Arm Chairs Recalled by Ross Stores Due to Fall and Injury Hazard
summary: The chair may tip or slide backward, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 560.

title: Thirteen Manufacturers, Distributors Recall Bicycles with Front Disc Brakes to Replace Quick Release Lever Due to Crash Hazard
summary: An open quick release lever on the bicycle's front wheel hub can come into contact with the front disc brake rotor causing the front wheel to come to a sudden stop or separate from the bicycle, posing a risk of injury to the rider. Units: About 1.3 million (in addition about 245,000 bikes were sold

title: Bed Bath & Beyond Hammock Stands Recalled by Pride Family Brands Due To Fall Hazard
summary: Z-shaped hooks that attach the hammock to the hammock stand can bend or break, resulting in a consumer falling to the ground. Units: About 13,900 (an additional 55 units sold in Canada).

title: Fujitsu America Recalls Battery Packs for Fujitsu Notebook Computers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery packs can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 300 (in addition, about 5 were sold in Canada).

title: Rainbow Play Systems Recalls Plastic Yellow Trapeze Rings Due to Fall Hazard; Manufactured by Nylacarb
summary: The rings can unexpectedly crack or break during use, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 121,000 pairs of rings in the United States (in addition about 6,500 were sold in Canada and about 5,500 in Mexico).

title: Wishbone Design Recalls Recycled Edition Bikes Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The handlebar can pinch fingers placed at the center where the handlebar connects to the bike frame. Units: About 400 (an additional 4,600 were sold outside the United States).

title: CleggPromo Recalls CPB-100 Power Banks Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The power bank can overheat, explode and catch fire. Units: About 1,500.
